{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Push Dev Images to Quay
on:
  deployment:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-images:
    name: Dev images
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: "mandrel builder images (dev)"
            modules: "quarkus-mandrel-builder-image"
            args: "-Pdev"

    steps:
    - name: Install Podman and qemu
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install podman qemu-user-binfmt binfmt-support
        sudo update-binfmts --enable qemu-aarch64
        sudo systemctl restart systemd-binfmt
    - name: Re-claim some disk space
      run: |
        sudo swapoff -a
        sudo rm -rf /swapfile /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android \
        /usr/local/share/powershell /usr/share/swift /usr/local/.ghcup
        sudo apt-get clean
        podman system prune -a -f
        sudo podman system prune -a -f
        df -h
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
    - uses: actions/setup-java@77dd5b2ce225ea11469928ac317850245a74ae78 # v6.2.0
      with:
        distribution: 'temurin'
        java-version: '17'
    - name: Cache Maven packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
    - name: Build ${{ matrix.name }}
      run: mvn install --batch-mode --projects ${{ matrix.modules }} --also-make -DskipTests ${{ matrix.args }}
    - name: Test ${{ matrix.name }}
      env:
          DOCKER_GHA_BUILDX: true
      run: |
        set -x
        set +e
        # Deal with spaces in image descriptions
        NM="${{ matrix.name }}"
        NM="${NM// /_}"
        # DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME is used in the testsuite
        export DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME=testsuite-logs-${NM}.txt
        echo "DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME=${DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        EXIT_CODE=0
        if [[ "${{ matrix.modules }}" == quarkus-mandrel* ]]; then
          echo "┌── Testing ${{ matrix.name }}" >> ${DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME}
          podman run -t dev-amd64 native-image --version
          mvn install --batch-mode --projects ${{ matrix.modules }} --also-make -DskipTests -Ptest ${{ matrix.args }}
          EXIT_CODE=$?
          if [[ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]]; then
            echo "└── Done with errors: ${{ matrix.name }}" >> ${DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME}
          else
            echo "└── Done: ${{ matrix.name }}" >> ${DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME}
          fi
        else
          echo "═╡ SKIPPED: Testing ${{ matrix.name }}" >> ${DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME}
        fi
        exit $EXIT_CODE
    - name: Upload test summary
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
      with:
        name: ${{ env.DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME }}
        path: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ env.DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME }}
    - name: Print results ${{ matrix.name}}
      if: always()
      run: |
        podman images
        cat '${{ github.workspace }}/${{ env.DOCKER_GHA_SUMMARY_NAME }}'
    - name: Log in to Quay.io
      uses: redhat-actions/podman-login@50c2d9a331bb67c8fdab99b86455fad05e2e3252 # v2.0
      with:
        registry: quay.io
        username: ${{ secrets.QUAY_USER }}
        password: ${{ secrets.QUAY_TOKEN }}
    - name: Push ${{ matrix.name }}
      run: mvn install --batch-mode --projects ${{ matrix.modules }} -DskipTests -Ppush ${{ matrix.args }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly builds Maven modules on schedule and dispatch, and the repository contains pom.xml files, so dependency downloads are repeated across runs. Evidence P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE measured adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.m2/repository keyed on the pom.xml hash, keeping the same build/test steps and success count while cutting median elapsed CI time about 51%. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE supports dependency-download caching as a general pattern. The change adds one cache step after setup-java and before the Maven build, preserving all existing build, test, upload, login, and push coverage, triggers, permissions, and secrets without adding privileged actions, publishing, deployment, or new network access beyond Maven's existing dependency resolution.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
